lines.text: کواکب مختلف میباشد بسبب اختلاف عرض بلاد در موضع واحد نیز مختلف میشود بسبب
lines.en: of the planets is different due to the difference in the latitude of the cities. In a single place, it also becomes different due to

lines.en: the abundance and scarcity of distance from the earth, and due to the difference in northern and southern latitude, and due to speed and slowness, and

lines.en: due to the abundance of ascensions and descensions of the parts of the zodiac signs. Therefore, the astrologers all together have determined a specific amount

lines.text: در هر کوکب منظور داشته اند اندرنجا سوا که چون میانه آفتاب وان کوکب بانمقدار
lines.en: for each planet, in degrees of the equator, that when between the sun and that planet is that amount

lines.en: it reaches the limit of being under the rays, before combustion or after it, and they have based the judgments on that,

lines.text: خواه کوکب مرئی باشد و خواه مخفی هر چند منظور و ملحوظ اهل حساب در حاشیه تقاویم
lines.en: whether the planet is visible or hidden, although what is considered and observed by the calculators in the margin of the ephemerides

lines.text: اول خفا و رؤیت باشد و زهره را مخصوص باین ساخته اند که هر گاه عرض زیاد در جهت
lines.en: is the beginning of hiding and visibility. And they have made Venus specific to this, that whenever the latitude is much in the direction

lines.text: درجه باشد چنانکه احتراق و صمیم بر او اطلاق نکنند تحت الشعاع نیز اطلاق نکنند و
lines.en: of the degree, such that combustion and cazimi are not applied to it, under the rays is also not applied, and

lines.text: وجه این ظاهر است وحد تحت الشعاع در سفلیین دوازده درجه مقرر کرده اند و در
lines.en: the reason for this is obvious. And the limit of being under the rays in the two inferiors they have established as twelve degrees, and in

lines.text: علویین پانزده درجه و مریخ هیجده درجه و دون این مقادیر در تحت شعاع افتاب
lines.en: the superiors fifteen degrees, and Mars eighteen degrees. And below these amounts, they are under the rays of the sun.

lines.text: باشند و اهل احکام تحت الشعاع را دلیل ضعف و حبس مرض دانند چنانکه گویند که
lines.en: And the astrologers consider being under the rays as a sign of weakness and imprisonment of illness, as they say that

lines.text: چون کوکب بشعاع افتاب در اید بمنزله شخصی بود که داخل زندان شود یا مریض گردد
lines.en: when a planet enters the rays of the sun, it is like a person who enters prison or becomes sick.

lines.text: و چون باحتراق رسد بمنزله شخصی بود که بهلاکت رسد و چون از احتراق خلاص شود
lines.en: And when it reaches combustion, it is like a person who perishes. And when it is freed from combustion,

lines.text: استاد ابوریحان گوید بمنزله شخصی زندانی نامتواری که بیرون اندزاهی سنجد یعنی اراده
lines.en: Master Abu Rayhan says it is like an unhidden imprisoned person who measures the outside, meaning he intends

lines.en: elders and chiefs and people of castles and inhabitants of mountains, and abundance of clouds and turbidity and darkness of the air, and

lines.text: امدن باران در وقت و حدوث غم و هم در خلایق و بطالت رعایا و اهل حرث ( خفای

lines.en: rains and unevenness of the air and killing, and in the third third, hunger and plague. (The hiding of Saturn in the sign of Taurus)

summary.headline: Saturn Hidden in the Zodiac Signs
summary.text: Discussion of planetary visibility and being under the rays, with limits of twelve degrees for the inferior planets, fifteen for the superior planets, and eighteen for Mars, plus comparisons by Abu Rayhan. Judgments attributed to Hermes begin with Saturn’s hiding in the twelve zodiac signs and its omens in Aries, Taurus, and Gemini.
